name: Shuklambaradharam Vishnum
text:
शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् ।
प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
meaning: I meditate on Vishnu, dressed in white, bright as the moon, four-armed, with a serene face, so that every obstacle may be calmed.
purpose: A commonly recited invocation for auspicious beginnings.
when: At the start of a practice or a piece of work.
note: The client list spells it “Shuklam Bharadharam”; the verse begins śuklāmbaradharam, “wearing white”.
